meta: Plan your move week by week with AI so you don't forget to cancel the internet, transfer utilities or lose things in boxes.

muc.title: Forgetting everything
muc.text: Only after moving do you remember you forgot to cancel the internet. AI makes a weekly plan so nothing slips.

muc.title: Moving date, people
muc.text: Tell AI the moving date, how many people and rooms, then ask for a plan split over four weeks.

muc.title: Sort, pack, notify, move
muc.text: Week one, declutter; week two, pack rarely used things; week three, transfer utilities; final week, pack everyday items.

muc.title: Number every box
muc.text: Ask AI for a table of box numbers, contents and destination rooms, so you don't open every box at the new place.

muc.title: Thirty tasks before moving day
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to list thirty tasks before moving day, sorted by week.
